args.sql:
SELECT 
    pi.productid,
    p.name,
    pi.locationid,
    pi.quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS ranking
FROM adventureworks.production.productinventory pi
JOIN adventureworks.production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4
ORDER BY pi.locationid, pi.quantity DESC

arguments.question: 查询locationID在 3 到 4 之间的库存产品，按其数量进行排名。结果需按LocationID进行分区，并根据数量进行排序。返回字段包括：产品 ID、名称、库位 ID、数量及其排名
